title: Wednesday home strength
subtitle: ~25 min · all at home · after work, easy to start
feeling: Tired and low on energy after being sick last week. Want a short, doable workout at home.
note: Keep it moderate, about 6 out of 10, and stop each set with 3 reps left. Short rests keep your heart rate up, so you don't need the treadmill. If your legs are still sore, use lighter weights.

items.name: March in place, arm circles, hip circles
items.cue: Get loose and warm before the weights.

sections.label: 2 · Circuit · 3 rounds
sections.instructions: Do all 4 moves in a row with no rest between them. Rest 30 seconds after the last move. Repeat 3 times.

items.name: Goblet squat
items.cue: One 20 lb dumbbell held at your chest. Sit down and stand up with control.

items.name: Push-up
items.cue: Knees down is fine. Chest nearly to the floor.

items.name: One-arm row
items.cue: One 15-20 lb dumbbell. Free hand on a chair. Pull your elbow to your hip.

items.name: Shoulder press
items.cue: A 10-15 lb dumbbell in each hand. Press straight overhead.

sections.label: 3 · Cardio finisher
sections.instructions: 40 seconds hard, 20 seconds rest, 4 times. Jump rope outside is a fine swap if you bundle up.

items.name: Dumbbell thruster
items.cue: Two 15 lb dumbbells at your shoulders. Squat down, then stand and press overhead in one smooth motion.

items.name: Stretch and slow breathing
items.cue: Stretch hips, glutes, chest and back. Breathe in through your nose, out slowly through your mouth.
